arxiv-2101-08471.title: Collaborative Teacher-Student Learning via Multiple Knowledge Transfer
arxiv-2101-08471.creator: Liyuan Sun, Jianping Gou, Baosheng Yu, Lan Du, Dacheng Tao
arxiv-2101-08471.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Liyuan Sun, Jianping Gou, Baosheng Yu, Lan Du, Dacheng Tao. Knowledge distillation (KD), as an efficient and effective model compression technique, has been receiving considerable attention in deep learning. The key to its success is to transfer knowledge from a large teacher network to a small student one. However, most of the existing knowledge distillation methods consider only one type of knowledge learned from either instance features or instance relations via a specific distillation strategy in teacher-student learning.

arxiv-2305-08947.title: Tests of the Charge Convexity Conjecture in Caswell-Banks-Zaks Theory
arxiv-2305-08947.creator: Ofer Aharony, Yacov-Nir Breitstein
arxiv-2305-08947.description: Abstract The Charge Convexity Conjecture (CCC) states that in a unitary conformal field theory in d ≥ 3 d\geq 3 dimensions with a global symmetry, the minimal dimension of operators in certain representations of the symmetry, as a function of the charge q q of the representation (or a generalized notion of it), should be convex.

arxiv-2307-14399.title: Probing reflection from aerosols with the near-infrared dayside spectrum of WASP-80b
arxiv-2307-14399.creator: Bob Jacobs, Jean-Michel Désert, Peter Gao, Caroline V. Morley, Jacob Arcangeli, Saugata Barat, Mark S. Marley, Julianne I. Moses, Jonathan J. Fortney, Jacob L. Bean, Kevin B. Stevenson, Vatsal Panwar
arxiv-2307-14399.description: Abstract The presence of aerosols is intimately linked to the global energy budget and the composition of a planet’s atmospheres. Their ability to reflect incoming light prevents energy from being deposited into the atmosphere, and they shape spectra of exoplanets.

arxiv-2308-04977.creator: Shizuo Kaji, Kenji Kajiwara and Shota Shigetomi
arxiv-2308-04977.description: Abstract . We consider the configuration space of points on the two-dimensional sphere that satisfy a specific system of quadratic equations. We construct periodic orbits in this configuration space using elliptic theta functions and show that they satisfy semi-discrete analogues of mKdV and sine-Gordon equations.

pmc-12397119.title: 5-year clinical outcome of the ESTOIH trial comparing the short-bite versus large-bite technique for elective midline abdominal closure
pmc-12397119.creator: René H. Fortelny, Petra Baumann, Anna Hofmann, Stefan Riedl, Jan Ludolf Kewer, Jessica Hoelderle, Andreas Shamiyeh, Bettina Klugsberger, Theo David Maier, Guido Schumacher, Ferdinand Köckerling, Guido Wöste, Ursula Pession, Markus Albertsmeier

pmc-12705941.title: Predictive Value of Patient-Derived Tumor Cell Cluster–Based Drug Sensitivity Assay in Advanced NSCLC
pmc-12705941.creator: Yangchun Gu, Leilei Yang, Hua Zhang, Shenyi Yin, Lu Yang, Zhentao Liu, Jinyu Yu, Huiying Huang, Juan Li, Baoshan Cao
pmc-12705941.description: Background:Patient-derived tumor cell cluster (PTC)-based drug sensitivity assays show promise for enabling precision drug selection; however, their predictive value in advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) requires further elucidation.Methods:To assess the concordance between PTC-based drug sensitivity and clinical outcomes, we conducted a single-center prospective cohort study at Peking University Third Hospital from August 2021 to August 2024.

pmc-13144963.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1307 NODDI METRICS CORRELATED WITH HAND-GRIP RECOVERY AFTER STROKE: A LONGITUDINAL MULTI-SHELL DIFFUSION MRI STUDY
pmc-13144963.creator: Emmanuelle Gourieux, Loïc Legris, Johan Pietras, Aurélien Delphin, Alexandre Krainik, Olivier Detante, Assia Jaillard
pmc-13144963.description: Background and aimsFractional anisotropy (FA) is an established MRI biomarker of stroke motor recovery, but conventional single-shell diffusion imaging has limited sensitivity, particularly in the chronic phase. Multi-shell diffusion enables improved modeling of white matter micro-structure using biophysical approaches such as Neurite Orientation Dispersion and Density Imaging (NODDI).

pmc-13181379.title: Nutritional Supplementation Combined with Exercise for Musculoskeletal Health in Women: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis Evaluating Proteins, Amino Acids, and Creatine across Reproductive Stages
pmc-13181379.creator: Kee-Hsin Chen, Tzu-Pei Yeh, Shu-Cheng Lin, Pi-Ju Liu, Dorothy Bai, I-Hui Chen
pmc-13181379.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundWomen experience progressive musculoskeletal deterioration across reproductive stages, with accelerated changes during the menopausal transition. Exercise provides established benefits, but the additive effects of nutritional supplementation strategies, including proteins, amino acids, and related compounds such as creatine, remain uncertain. Previous systematic reviews focused on older adults aged 65 years and above, leaving a knowledge gap regarding women facing unique metabolic challenges related to reproductive hormones.

pmc-13336850.description: Genome‐wide association studies (GWAS) link the Tropomyosin 1 (Tpm1) locus to quantitative blood trait variation, but related mechanisms are unclear. Murine Tpm1 deficiency enhances hemogenic endothelial cell (HEC) specification, but it was unclear if these effects extended to postnatal hematopoiesis.

uslaw-usc-t42-s2000c.title: 42 U.S.C. § 2000c — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t42-s2000c.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s2000c.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 21 (Civil Rights); Subchapter IV (Public Education). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. As used in this subchapter— (a) “Secretary” means the Secretary of Education. (b) “Desegregation” means the assignment of students to public schools and within such schools without regard to their race, color, religion, sex or national origin, but “desegregation”.
